messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Service: /v1/generate — increased 5xx rate detected (region: us-west-2). Severity: P2. Paging oncall: @Maya R.
Maya R: On it — I'm taking the page. Starting triage.
Carlos T: I can help with logs and recent deploys. Any recent rollouts?
Maya R: No deploys in last 45m. Initial quick look: multiple 502s from inference-gateway, appears to be upstream timeout to runtime pools.
Elliot (SRE): I'm pulling the autoscaler and runtime node health. Will DM if I need to take over.
Priya S: Noted customer impact? Any errors surfaced to clients?
Maya R: Early datapoint: API client error rate spikes ~2.8% for 15m window, some long-tail latencies. Flagging potential partial outage for a subset of customers on Dedicated capacity.
Joan (Comms): Heads-up — if this persists past 30m we'll need a status page update and a short customer note. Drafting standby language.
incident-bot: @Maya R — you have a scheduled handoff with @Carlos T in 12m. Use `!handoff` to trigger.
Maya R: Will do handoff in 10. Quick mitigation: setting fallback routing to low-cost-runtime-2 for affected region to reduce errors. Pushing policy now.
Carlos T: Confirming I can take continuity once the fallback is validated — please post the change result.
Maya R: Fallback policy applied. Observability: 502s down to 0.9% now. Latency stable but elevated.
Priya S: Great. Can we capture a concise customer impact summary (one sentence) for status page?
Maya R: "We experienced elevated error rates and increased latencies for text generation in US-West-2 impacting a subset of Dedicated customers; a routing fallback has reduced errors and we are monitoring."
Joan (Comms): Copy. Draft for status page (short):
```
Incident: Partial degraded availability of text generation in US-West-2
Status: Monitoring
Impact: A subset of Dedicated customers experienced elevated 5xx errors and increased latency.
Mitigation: Traffic routed to fallback runtime, error rate reduced.
Next update: 30 minutes or when status changes.
```
Joan (Comms): Draft customer email/snippet for notifications (short):
```
Subject: Brief service interruption affecting text generation (US-West-2)
Body: We detected elevated error rates and latency for text generation in the US-West-2 region affecting a subset of customers. Our engineers implemented a routing fallback which has reduced the errors. No action is required from your side. We will provide an update within 30 minutes or sooner if the situation changes.
```
Priya S: Can we align social/public wording — we should avoid specific SLA language and direct customers to status.redwood.ai. Also coordinate with Legal.
Joan (Comms): Proposed tweet/short public post (thread-safe):
```
We’re aware of a partial service disruption affecting text-generation in US-West-2. Engineers have routed traffic to a fallback runtime and error rates are improving. We’ll post updates on our status page: https://status.redwood.ai
```
Carlos T: +1. Maybe add: "No customer data exposure detected." if Legal clears it.
LegalBot: No customer data exposure indicated by current logs. Approve adding that line.
Joan (Comms): Updated public blurb: 
```
We’re aware of a partial service disruption affecting text-generation in US-West-2. Traffic has been routed to a fallback runtime and error rates are improving. No customer data exposure has been detected. See details on: https://status.redwood.ai
```
Maya R: Monitoring continues — metrics stable for 10m at reduced error rate. Will leave routing in place for 45m then assess rollback.
Elliot (SRE): I'll keep autoscaler paused on that pool until we verify steady-state to avoid flapping.
Priya S: For internal comms: short template for CSMs — can we finalize?
Joan (Comms): Internal CSM message (one-liner):
"Heads-up: brief degradation in US-West-2 impacted text generation for some Dedicated customers. Routing fallback applied; errors reduced. Refer to status.redwood.ai for updates and reach out to triage@redwood.ai for customer escalations."
Priya S: Good. Please include estimated ETA for full resolution when available.
Maya R: ETA: 45m for rollback check, may extend if we see oscillation.
Joan (Comms): I'll queue the status update for publication in 5m unless we need to escalate. Please react with :white_check_mark: when content is final.
Carlos T: :white_check_mark: content looks good from engineering side.
Priya S: :white_check_mark: CSM template approved.
LegalBot: :white_check_mark: legal cleared the public line about data exposure.
incident-bot: [LOG] Handoff recorded: @Maya R -> @Carlos T at 1781203520.
Maya R: Handed off to @Carlos T. Leaving the channel to focus on rollback tests.
Carlos T: Taking lead. Monitoring for 20m.
Joan (Comms): Publishing status now. Copy of status to be posted: (same as draft).
incident-bot: [STATUS PAGE] Published at 1781203655 by Joan (Comms).
Priya S: Scheduling a short internal postmortem doc once incident resolves — will tag oncall and SRE.
Elliot (SRE): Noted. I’ll collect node-level traces and autoscaler logs.
Carlos T: 20m check: metrics stable, 5xx at baseline. Starting rollback of fallback now in small canary.
Maya R: (DM to Carlos) if rollback causes spike, revert and keep fallback.
Carlos T: Canary looks clean for first batch. Proceeding to full rollback.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] Error rate returned to baseline. Status: Resolved for majority of customers. Last check at 1781203978.
Joan (Comms): Updating status to "Resolved" with post-incident note in 1 hour.
Priya S: Sending quick summary to CSMs now.
Joan (Comms): Final public note suggestion for social (tweet):
"Issue affecting text-generation in US-West-2 has been resolved. Traffic routing was used to mitigate impact while engineers remediated the root cause. We’ll share a post-incident summary on our status page soon."
Carlos T: LGTM.
LegalBot: All good.
Maya R: Thanks everyone — great coordination.
Joan (Comms): Filing comms artifacts to incident tracker. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
